body.error: Incorrect API key provided. You can obtain an API key from https://console.x.ai.

note: xAI answers an invalid key with HTTP 400, not 401; the machine-readable code is invalid-argument (a missing or empty credential is 401 unauthenticated:*). The request has no other argument, so the argument is the key
provenance: RECORDED from the live service on 2026-10-11 with a deliberately invalid key; never a real credential
